meta.naming: Keys are "<Collection>::<variable name>" exactly as in Figma. Find variables by this name, never by id.

Semantic::color/bg/overlay.name: color/bg/overlay
Semantic::color/bg/overlay.description: Modal/drawer scrim (50% gray-900 light, 70% black dark).

Semantic::color/border/input.name: color/border/input
Semantic::color/border/input.description: Border of form controls at rest (inputs, checkbox, radio). Meets ~3:1 against bg/primary.

Semantic::color/icon/inverse.name: color/icon/inverse
Semantic::color/icon/inverse.description: Icons on solid brand or dark surfaces

recolor_readiness.rule: Semantic tokens must only alias Primitives. Every item in semantic_tokens_with_raw_hex will NOT follow a recolor until it is re-pointed to a Primitive.
